name: forge-mine-capture
_note: OMEGA FORGE Wave 1 builder composition (D-409 split-plugin, D-417 §5 lane 1) — the capture seam boot: vivim.law (phase 0, gate + journal + the consent ceremony), vivim.vault (the proposal ledger the receipt lands in), and forge.mine.capture loaded AS A PLUGIN with forge.mine.capture@1 routed normally. The op is EXTERNAL_MUTATION (pack.builder FORGE_OP_CATALOG), so the host gates it through law.check@1 BEFORE the handler ever runs: the EXTERNAL_MUTATION class default is require-consent, so a caller performs the consent ceremony (law.consent.grant@1) and only then is the foreign tree read at all. The op READS the declared mine root and never writes it; its single mutation is the append-only receipt row in vault ns proposal (D-409 SF1), read back byte-identical before the receipt is returned. The READ siblings (forge.mine.verify/diff/list@1) are NOT routed here — they are the separate forge-mine plugin (D-409, one risk class per plugin). This is a builder composition: no product composition may route forge.* ops (FORGE_IN_PRODUCT).
